title: Customer churn signals
summary: Score explicit cancellation intent in a support note.
why: An account dashboard needs a signal rather than a generated account plan.

intent.instructions: Rate expressed intent to stop using the product.
criteria: Explicit request to cancel or leave

state.note: Please cancel my subscription. We moved to another product.
How do I invite another teammate?

limitation: A semantic feature, not a churn forecast. No personal demographic inference or account action occurs.
